mainEntity.name: How much does a wrongful death lawyer cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most wrongful death lawyers work on a contingency fee basis. This means you do not pay any upfront legal fees. Instead, the lawyer's fees are a percentage of the final settlement or court award. If the case is not successful, you typically do not owe any attorney fees. This arrangement allows families to pursue justice without immediate financial burden during a difficult time.
